messages:
Sam: Quick poll — who's bringing lunch tomorrow? Sushi :sushi: or sandwiches :sandwich:?
Priya: Sushi for me! If there's sashimi, I volunteer to split it 🍣
Jordan: Sandwiches. Hot take: warm baguette > cold rice.
Li: @Jordan controversial but I respect the hustle :laughing: Also can someone water my little desk fern? I'll be OOO.
OpsBot: Reminder — fridge cleanup on Friday at 4pm. Please label items or they'll be liberated.
Sam: Also tiny vote: which desk has the sunniest spot today? Me (window side) or @Priya? :sun_with_face:
Priya: You take the sun, Sam. I prefer ambient plant shadows.
Jordan: Can we start a "desk dog of the week"? Nominate pups here and we'll do a sticker vote.
Li: I will bring stickers. Color-coded democracy. :label: :sticker: 
Priya: Kudos to @Sam for finding the lost travel mug under the ficus yesterday :raised_hands:
Sam: That mug owes me loyalty. Found it with a Post-it that said "be brave" :sweat_smile:
Jordan: <https://giphy.com/gifs/puppy-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI|puppy gif> perfect mood booster
Priya: Counting lunch votes: Sushi 2, Sandwiches 1. Sticker budget approved by Li.
Li: I'll drop off stickers at 11:45. Also leaving a tiny sign by the fern: "water me pls" :seedling:
Sam: Perfect. If anyone wants to carpool to the sushi place, ping me.
Jordan: I'll join, bring extra napkins.
OpsBot: Note: new microwave etiquette posted in #kitchen — reheat in covered containers only.
Priya: A+ etiquette, OpsBot. See y'all at lunch! :wave:
